avis.titre: Refresh Your Day and Unwind Your Night with This Dual-Action Face Wash Set
avis.texte: If you're like me and want to start your mornings with a burst of energy and end your nights with a touch of tranquility, this two-pack of oil-free facial cleansers is just what your skincare routine needs. The Morning Burst and Night Relaxing duo has quickly become my go-to for keeping my skin looking fresh and feeling clean, all while fitting seamlessly into my daily routine. The Morning Burst cleanser is a fantastic way to wake up your skin. Infused with vitamin C and bursting with a delightful citrus scent, it really does give you that invigorating morning pick-me-up. The gentle exfoliating action with BHA and plastic-free beads works wonders on my skin, removing impurities and unclogging pores without leaving it feeling dry or tight. It’s such a refreshing way to jumpstart my day, and I love how it makes my skin feel renewed and ready to face whatever comes my way. As the day winds down, the Night Relaxing cleanser is like a soothing retreat for my skin. The calming aromas and the blend of hyaluronic acid, sea kelp extract, and deep sea minerals help wash away the stresses of the day. My skin feels so soft and pampered after using it, and I find the gentle formula is perfect for maintaining my skin’s moisture barrier. Plus, knowing it’s free from harsh chemicals and vegan-friendly makes me appreciate the mindful formulation even more. This skincare duo stands out not just for its effectiveness but also for its thoughtful touches. The fact that it's dermatologist-tested a

avis.titre: Fantastic Value, Not Drying, and Perfect for All-Day Use!
avis.texte: This 2-pack is a fantastic find! The value you get when buying the Morning Burst and Night Relaxing together is great, and the quality is excellent for daily use. Non-Drying Formula: This is the biggest win. Both cleansers are not drying at all, which is crucial for oil-free products. Our skin feels clean, fresh, and soft, never tight or stripped. Total Versatility: We love that we can use the two formulas interchangeably—they are both gentle enough for morning or evening use, even though the scents are different. Pleasant Scents: The Morning Burst has that refreshing citrus scent to wake you up, and the Night Relaxing is calming. Oil-Free Confidence: The oil-free formula is great for managing shine and keeping skin clear. Highly Recommended: This is a perfect, budget-friendly duo that delivers gentle, effective cleansing every time.

avis.titre: Take it from someone with sensitive skin
avis.texte: I am incredibly acne-prone, my skin is very likely to experience redness if a product isn't for me. I also have very sensitive skin as I suffer from psoriasis. I had used both of these years ago and decided to buy them again when I saw them, and I don't regret it at all despite some issues. Just like I have sensitive skin, I also don't do well with strong scents, so the Morning Burst one was a bit too much for me. It has a strong citrusy scent that didn't agree with my sensitive skin. However, my mother doesn't have this issue with scents and she LOVES it! Now, the Night Relaxing one almost feels like a holy grail for me. It's gentle, generates a good amount of soapiness and cleans very well. My skin feels clean and soft, without feeling tight or stripped of essential natural oils. In addition to that, it doesn't really have a strong scent! Just awesome. I use the night relaxing one at every hour of the day I decide to wash my face.

Amazing value! This clean & clear two pack morning burst and night relaxing face cleanser are the perfect pairing. Gentle yet effective, skin friendly and oil free. The two different fragrances are to help relax and delight your senses. 5-Star quality and value, highly recommend!

I’ve been using the Clean & Clear Morning Burst Facial Cleanser and I’m really impressed with the results. It has a refreshing citrus scent that instantly wakes you up, making it perfect for a morning routine. The formula is gentle on the skin but still does a great job removing oil, dirt, and impurities without leaving my face feeling dry or tight. I especially like the tiny bursting beads—they give a light exfoliating effect that makes my skin feel smoother and more energized. After using it consistently, my skin looks brighter and feels clean and refreshed. Overall, it’s a great affordable cleanser for daily use, especially if you have normal to oily skin. I would definitely recommend it!

Estaba en búsqueda de productos para limpieza facial, toda vez que el limpiador que usaba anteriormente, si bien me funcionó un tiempo, después sólo me sacó un brote tras otro No me podía decidir sobre cuál comprar hasta que ví este dúo; recordé que hace varios años la marca era más o menos popular en cuanto a ayudar al control del acné leve a moderado y decidí probarla. Aunque soy una persona práctica y no me entusiasma la idea de tener usar un producto por la noche y otro de día para lo mismo, la verdad es un buen sistema. El jabón de noche limpia suavemente, huele muy rico y quita bien los restos de maquillaje (obviamente hay que desmaquillarse antes, no puede hacer todo por sí solo), la piel se siente limpia y queda con un brillo natural muy lindo. Por su parte, el jabón de día menciona que tiene vitamina C y unas microesferas limpiadoras (más como un exfoliante ligero), dice también que es para vigorizar la piel por la mañana y al parecer lo cumple, al terminar de lavarme el rostro puedo sentirlo muy fresco, terso y limpio sin sensación tirante o acartonada. Por último, ya como nota adicional, me cortó los brotes de tajo, apenas voy para la segunda semana de uso y veo la mejoría en mi piel. Normalmente trato de no reseñar los productos hasta no llevar de mínimo un mes de uso para ser lo más puntual posible, pero estoy muy sorprendida y contenta con la velocidad a la que dio resultados. Espero no cambien la fórmula porque es buenísimo de verdad y pienso volver a comprarlo

Great value for money – getting two cleansers in one pack is super convenient • Does a decent, reliable job of cleansing without overcomplicating things • Perfect for everyday use – simple and effective • Long-term dependable – I’ve been using this consistently for about 2 years • Easy to keep one in each bathroom (very practical!) Cons: • Nothing “extra” or luxurious – it’s basic and doesn’t have any special skincare benefits • Doesn’t feel very different between the morning and night versions • May not suit those looking for premium or targeted skincare results Final Verdict: If you’re looking for a no-fuss, budget-friendly face wash that simply gets the job done, this is a solid choice. I keep coming back to it because it works for me, and I’d rather spend more on other skincare products than on cleansers. Not fancy, but reliable—and sometimes that’s exactly what you need.

I know everyone’s skin is different so I’m not gonna come right out and say nobody should buy this. But, I’ve never had a reaction to a skincare product before, not like this anyway. Sometimes I get a little more acne, but this time, it actually made my skin rough and patchy, and under my eyes it made them RAW. One morning I woke up and my under eyes were actually bright pink and puffy, and stayed that way all day. You can see in the pictures, the main problems areas were around my mouth and nose and eyes. The skin is rough to the touch and eventually it becomes flaky, and it seems no amount of moisturizer can cover this up for a whole day. One morning after my eyes had also developed the roughness and patchiness, I tried to put in concealer and it made it look worse, it just enhanced the flaky dry skin. Not to mention it hurts to rub it or wash it, those poor areas are totally raw. Also, it’s weird because the morning cleanser BURNS my face but the nighttime one doesn’t. I’m going to experiment and see if it’s just the morning one I’m reacting to. Luckily I already got my money back so if I have to throw both of these away it’s no big deal. But hopefully I can still use the nighttime one… will update I really wanted to be able to use this because they smell so good. When it says the night cleanser smells relaxing, they’re not wrong.
